description: This file provides Windows-specific utilities for the fsmonitor feature, including functions to check remote protocols, determine if a filesystem is remote, and retrieve filesystem info, primarily by interacting with Windows API calls such as CreateFileW, GetFileInformationByHandleEx, and GetDriveTypeW.

methods.name: int check_remote_protocol(wchar_t * wpath)
methods.description: Checks the remote protocol information of a given file path using Windows API calls, returning -1 on failure.

methods.name: int fsmonitor__get_fs_info(const char * path,struct fs_info * fs_info)
methods.description: Determines whether the filesystem at a given path is remote by inspecting drive type and protocol info.

methods.name: int fsmonitor__is_fs_remote(const char * path)
methods.description: Public wrapper that checks if a filesystem at a given path is remote.

methods.name: int fsmonitor__get_alias(const char * path UNUSED,struct alias_info * info UNUSED)
methods.description: Placeholder function for getting alias info; currently a no-op.

methods.name: char * fsmonitor__resolve_alias(const char * path UNUSED,const struct alias_info * info UNUSED)
methods.description: Placeholder function for resolving an alias to a path; currently returns NULL.
